settings.title: Foundation Skin Science Certification
settings.description: A comprehensive grounding in skin anatomy, the science of skin health, and professional consultation. The essential starting point for advanced practice.

settings.title: Laser Safety & Operation Certification
settings.description: Certified training in laser physics, safety protocols, and supervised hands-on operation for hair removal and skin treatments.

settings.title: Microblading & Semi-Permanent Makeup
settings.description: Brow mapping, pigment theory, and microblading technique with live-model practice and aftercare protocols.

settings.title: Advanced Chemical Peels Masterclass
settings.description: Master the application of enzymatic, AHA/BHA, and clinical-grade peels for pigmentation, acne, and rejuvenation.

settings.title: Dermaplaning & Microdermabrasion Workshop
settings.description: Hands-on technique training in physical exfoliation methods for instant, visible results.

settings.title: Injectables Fundamentals
settings.description: For doctors and nurses: anti-wrinkle and dermal filler theory, facial anatomy, and supervised practical training. Medical qualification required.

settings.question: Who are these courses for?
settings.answer: Our certifications are designed for aspiring and practising aestheticians, beauty therapists, and medical professionals looking to expand their clinical skill set. Medical-only modules require a relevant qualification or licence.

settings.question: Do I receive a certificate?
settings.answer: Yes. Every course concludes with a DIBI Milano Academy certificate of completion, awarded on successful assessment.

settings.question: Are there prerequisites?
settings.answer: Foundation courses have no prerequisites. Advanced and medical modules require prior certification or a relevant medical licence.

settings.question: How do I enrol?
settings.answer: Message us on WhatsApp or call the centre to check upcoming intake dates and reserve your place. Class sizes are limited to ensure hands-on attention.

settings.question: Important Information
settings.answer: Course fees are subject to 18% VAT. Schedules and pricing may vary by intake.

settings.hero_subheading: Professional training in advanced skin science and aesthetics.
settings.intro_body: The DIBI Milano Academy brings the rigour of our clinic into the classroom. Our programmes pair the science of skin health with hands-on, mentor-led practice, so you graduate ready to deliver results with confidence and care.
settings.courses_subtitle: Structured, assessment-based programmes and focused masterclasses that build the clinical foundation for a career in advanced aesthetics.
settings.cta_subtext: Reserve your place in an upcoming intake, or message us to find the course that's right for you.
